versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Contrast Poster Prompt skill.

- Enables users to generate high-quality English AI drawing prompts and Chinese poster copy for 15 contrast gameplay styles.
- Matches the most suitable contrast type(s) based on user needs and creative scenarios.
- Supports various poster formats: split-screen comparison, single image, combination contrast, and text-focused cognitive contrast.
- Provides recommended Chinese copy and applicable platform suggestions for each prompt.
- Offers clarifying questions if user input is incomplete, ensuring more accurate poster suggestions.
